rulings.model: Eligibility tests the filer alone where the IRS also counts the spouse on a joint return. Step 1 Q2 asks "Do you, and your spouse if filing a joint return, have a social security number...", and Step 4 Q2 asks "Were you, or your spouse if filing a joint return, at least age 25 but under age 65" and Q3 asks about "your main home, and your spouse's if filing a joint return". The program's inputs ask only "Do you have an SSN" and "Were you born", so a joint return can get a different result.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. The spouse variants of the SSN and age tests arise only on a joint return, and married filing statuses are refused (s3.married); within scope the filer's own tests are the tests. The Step 4 birth-date boundary follows the instructions since BUG-0034.
